tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. The ground the masthead and the three eyes sit on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: event intake, engine verdict, human gate, audit ledger. Inputs fill with it too.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: Rule 16 output code block, ledger header row, empty states, read-only values.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels, table rows and fieldsets. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons). 3:1 or better on surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, column headers, metadata strips, 'treated as data' notes. On paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Peacock ink, Trinetra's identity hue. Primary buttons, links, active step, Eye I. Text on surface and paper.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind brand badges and the selected row. brand text reads on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on brand and fail fills (primary and override buttons).

tokens.name: eye-perceive
tokens.usage: Eye I · Pratyaksha (perceive): intake and classification. Same hue as brand.

tokens.name: eye-perceive-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Eye I numerals and step markers.

tokens.name: eye-measure
tokens.usage: Eye II · Ganita (measure): quantification and capital. Ochre. Text on surface, paper and eye-measure-soft.

tokens.name: eye-measure-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Eye II numerals and the capital-effect panel header.

tokens.name: eye-discern
tokens.usage: Eye III · Viveka (discern): escalation and human gate. Madder. Text on surface, paper and eye-discern-soft.

tokens.name: eye-discern-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind Eye III numerals and the human-gate panel header.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Rule passed, evidence supported, DQ band high. Blue rather than green, so it stays distinct from fail for colour-blind readers. Always paired with a ✓ glyph and a word.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pass badges and passing rule-trace rows.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Data gap, matrix gap, provisional value, DQ band medium. Always paired with a ! glyph and a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn badges and the illustrative-data notice.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Rule failed, injection screen hit, mandatory field missing, DQ band low. Always paired with a ✕ glyph and a word.

tokens.name: fail-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind fail badges and field error messages.

tokens.name: on-fail
tokens.usage: Text on a fail fill (the Override button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element. 3:1 or better on paper, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Product masthead only, once per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Panel titles: Event intake, Engine verdict, Audit ledger.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Eye card titles and verdict sub-panels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above an eye or panel title. Set the text in capitals in the markup; the style does not transform it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every output is deterministic, cited and routed to a human gate.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Corrections create a new version. Nothing is edited in place.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, checkbox labels, button text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline amounts and scores: gross loss, net loss, DQ score, ILM delta. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Rule IDs, circular references, event IDs, input hashes, Rule 16 output.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Metadata strip values and ledger hash cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text gap in badges; checkbox-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap; badge horizontal padding; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; table cell padding; rule-trace row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a fieldset grid; panel inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding; gap between fieldsets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the three eye cards and between major panels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Masthead vertical padding; space above a panel title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margin on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, buttons, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and eye cards. The largest radius in the system: Trinetra is a ledger, not a toy.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Eye numerals (circles) and the DQ meter track only.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for panels: they are separated by line borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Open select menus and popovers only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel, input and table borders.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; the top rule over the masthead and the eye-colour rule on top of each eye card.
